actions.what: run the project's checks in the worktree

actions.name: review

actions.name: tidy

actions.what: push the branch and open a draft pull request

actions.name: pull_request_in_browser
actions.what: the branch's pull request in the browser

actions.name: refresh_tickets
actions.what: fetch the tickets again

actions.name: another_agent
actions.what: start another agent on it, in a worktree of its own

actions.what: the ticket in the browser

actions.what: close the ticket in its tracker, after asking; then clean up

actions.name: next_part

actions.name: previous_part

actions.what: read the settings again, after editing a file by hand

actions.name: remove_plugin
actions.what: remove the plugin, after asking

actions.what: these keys
